info.name: FlowOps Phase 4 Authenticated QA
info.description: Stage 4F: sequential authenticated Admin/Member lifecycle, user-backed assignment, body-only comments, activity, negative paths and optimistic concurrency. Select the placeholder-only local environment and privately fill credentials before running. See docs/qa/postman-guide.md. Use an isolated disposable database. No tokens or credentials are logged by scripts.

item.name: Negative Authorization
item.description: Intentional 401/403/400/404 responses pass their assertions. They must not overwrite successful WorkItem versions or auth tokens. Member B is unrelated again after Admin unassigns.

exec: pm.test('Login failure is generic', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().detail).to.eql('Invalid email or password.'); });

pm.test('Validation is specifically expectedVersion', function () { const keys = Object.keys(pm.response.json().errors || {}); pm.expect(keys.some(function (key) { return key.toLowerCase() === 'expectedversion'; })).to.eql(true); });
